task: I need to set up a new project in ClickUp for our upcoming 'Feature X' development. I'll add a few key tasks, assign them, and set due dates. Then, I want to create a custom field to track 'Priority' and set up a Kanban board view to visualize progress. Finally, I'll update a task's priority and move it to a different status.

observations.what: Sign-up needed email, then a second form with name/password, a reCAPTCHA image challenge and a 4-digit emailed code before onboarding.

Onboarding ran about 8 screens (use type, team, referral source, invites, imports, features, integrations, workspace name), and the features screen silently refused Next until at least one feature was picked, followed by a Free vs 14-day trial modal.
The inline Add Task row stays open after Enter, so the second Feature X task was added with a single typed line and a 'Task created' toast offered View task / Copy URL.
The + at the end of the list header opened a Fields panel where Dropdown was the first popular type, and a 'Priority' field with High/Low options was created in four actions on the free plan.
The dropdown field form starts with placeholder options 'Option 1' and 'Option 2' that have to be overwritten one at a time, and the Fields panel covers most of the task list while open.
ClickUp already has a built-in flag-style Priority on every card, so creating a custom 'Priority' dropdown gives no warning about duplicating that built-in field.
A Board (Kanban) view tab already existed on the list next to List, so the Kanban view needed one click rather than setup.
Dragging the Demo Alpha card from TO DO to IN PROGRESS worked in one drag, with column counts updating immediately (5 to 4, 0 to 1).

The new workspace was pre-filled with Project 1, Project 2 and placeholder Task 1-3 items, so my Feature X tasks ended up mixed in with demo clutter unless I spent extra steps creating a new list or deleting them.
A Brain AI chat panel opened by default and took about a third of the screen, which squeezed the list so task names and the custom field column were truncated.
I spent about 25 of 39 steps on sign-up and onboarding and ran out before adding a third task, assignees, due dates, or setting a Priority value on a task.
